School pickup is the best part of the day. Your kid spots you and runs.

Coming back to your dog is a big moment too. Plan to be there and enjoy it.

How it works: pick up before 10 AM on your last day and that last day is free. Pick up is 9 AM to 12 PM or 4 PM to 6:30 PM, 7 days a week.

Near Miramar or Pembroke Pines? Send us your dates and tell us about your dog.
